note: Engine stall-ledger reasons -> ncu warp-stall classes. Ordered; the first matching rule wins. Every rule is a hypothesis written from the ncu class descriptions until a single-stall kernel of tools/microbench decides it (evidence becomes `calibrated`, source names the protocol). No rule is tuned on a suite case.
